Inside was a sheet of paper, brown with salt, bearing only nine words: “The light is out on Bellweather Reef. Come quickly.” Bellweather had been abandoned for forty years. All morning he tried to persuade himself that it was a joke, yet each time he climbed the tower he saw a pale blink beyond the horizon. By evening he had packed bread, matches, and his father’s old compass. He left the lamp burning, lowered the little boat, and rowed into the violet water. Behind him, the great beam swept the empty shore. Ahead, something answered once, then waited.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时调低了音量的机器。高楼的窗还亮着零星几盏，便利店把白光铺在空荡的人行道上。环卫车缓慢转过街角，水花惊起一只灰鸽。早餐铺升起第一缕热气，夜班结束的人裹紧外套，沉默地等首班公交。天色由黑变蓝，露珠停在冬青叶尖。此刻无人催促，整座城在梦与清醒之间，轻轻呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a smaller box inside each box, until you find one with a prize and no box inside.\n- That last box is the stopping point; then you pass the prize back through every box you opened."}
